text.en:
Section one of Republic Act Numbered Sixty-five hundred and eighty is hereby amended to read
"Sec. 1. The Central Ilocos Sur Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Narvacan, Province of Ilocos Sur
is hereby converted into a general hospital to be known as Central Ilocos Sur General Hospital. This Hospital
shall have a fifty bed capacity."
